 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. MELBOURNE, Australia (AP) — Australia won the toss and decided to bowl in the first of five Twenty20 cricket internationals on Saturday at the Melbourne Cricket Ground.
 Henry Crocombe will make his T20 debut for England after making his ODI debut earlier this year.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement England won the one-day international series 2-1, including a 97-run win in the decider at Hobart on Wednesday.
 The teams play the second T20 on Tuesday at Carrara on the Gold Coast south of Brisbane.
 ___
 Lineups:
 Australia: Mitchell Marsh (captain), Jake Fraser-McGurk, Sam Harper, Tim David, Lachlan Shaw,Jack Edwards, Nikhil Chaudhary, Joel Davies, Ben Dwarshius, Riley Meredith, Adam Zampa
 England: Phil Salt, Aneurin Donald, Harry Brook (captain), Jordan Cox, Tom Banton, Will Jacks, Sam Curran, Jamie Overton, Liam Dawson, Adil Rashid, Henry Crocombe
